name: Probe
text: I'd like to see more than just a verification test on a subset of files, Fetch - can you provide a detailed changelog of the `link-coverage-report.py` script and evidence that it has been thoroughly tested against the current repository structure? text: DECISION: Fetch will provide a comprehensive changelog of the `link-coverage-report.py` script, evidencing thorough testing against the current repository structure, alongside metrics for measuring link coverage and a generated list, ensuring the artifact contains both the output and the methodologies used for accuracy verification.
